purpose_es: Conservar los 60 fondos y la captura extra en el README principal, ahora en inglés por petición expresa del dueño. Las nueve tomas de acción más atractivas abren la galería; main_readme_order fija el orden completo. La selección original de diez parejas y la extra conserva todos sus archivos.
purpose_en: Preserve all 60 backgrounds and the extra screenshot in the English main README. Nine visually selected action shots lead the gallery; main_readme_order pins the full sequence. Every file from the original ten-pair selection and the extra remains included.

main_readme_selection_reasons_en.charro-4-golpes.png: Four-hit combo clearly readable, both skull faces large and unobscured, clean symmetrical Gothic composition.
main_readme_selection_reasons_en.52-planetario-day.png: A visible bright impact spark beside Alexis’s face, Robot’s extended punch, clear faces and a lively bright Planetario backdrop.
main_readme_selection_reasons_en.32-mictlan-night.png: Visible two-hit counter and distinct reaction pose against moonlit water, candles and purple flames; rich color and mythological contrast.
main_readme_selection_reasons_en.54-planetario-apocalypse.png: Large bright cyan energy orb between the fighters, both faces legible, ruined Planetario and purple storm palette.
main_readme_selection_reasons_en.27-uam_azcapo-apocalypse.png: Airborne multi-armed Tzitzimime and clear Yoalli beneath a red moon and purple jacarandas; very dramatic stage depth.
main_readme_selection_reasons_en.19-unam_biblioteca_cu-day.png: Two-hit counter, fully extended police punch and readable Presidenta reaction, framed by the colorful UNAM mural and blue sky.
main_readme_selection_reasons_en.57-esm-apocalypse.png: Large airborne Planchada above Llorona with both faces clear; ESM lettering and teal/purple nighttime tones.
main_readme_selection_reasons_en.03-escom-apocalypse.png: Close, legible student faces, crouched cyan glow, neon ESCOM lettering and misty campus atmosphere.
main_readme_selection_reasons_en.44-piramidesol-night.png: Two-hit counter, spread multi-armed Tzitzimime pose and clear Estudianta; Pyramid stone backdrop adds a distinct mythological location.
